posts.text: Today’s @NYTGames Midi Crossword! So proud of this career milestone!! 😁

Historian @TimothyDSnyder sums up a year of Trump choices and policies in one overall conceptual framework, which he calls “Superpower suicide.”

Video

“As Americans, we have to be able to say it's not normal to wish for the destruction of an entire civilization.” Historian @TimothyDSnyder tells me why, when President Trump threatens to eradicate Iranian civilization, he "taints" all Americans by publicly using genocidal rhetoric.

Video

You can watch my full interview with President Zelensky @ZelenskyyUa here. We discussed the impact of the war in the Middle East and how he's navigating an increasingly complex relationship with the US. cnn.com/2026/04/22/tv/video/…

"We don’t have a large negotiation group from the United States, and... it’s a challenge that the same group is trying to manage both. What is important is not to forget about Ukraine." 

@ZelenskyyUa tells me he doesn’t foresee a ceasefire with Russia happening imminently because the US has “shifted” its attention to the Middle East. He also says he doesn't see any progress being likely on Ukraine until “the case of Iran” is “closed” or some kind of “fundamental ceasefire" is reached between th

"It’s really a question of our life, of survival... we need this money very much."

Speaking to me just hours after the EU finally approved a key 90 billion euro loan for Ukraine, President @ZelenskyyUa tells me that without the funds, Ukraine was struggling to manufacture the amount of weapons it's capable of producing--"Today we are producing a little bit less than 1,000 drone interceptors per day... but we can produce 2,000."

Video

In Odesa, the bombs continue to fall but a group of elderly Ukrainians are defiantly dressing up in an act of resistance. Journalist Alyona Synenko met with them and told me why they inspire her.

Video

As the Sudan war enters its fourth year, from my archives a painful reflection on an earlier moment in the country’s history, when I witnessed the same patterns of brutality, displacement and indifference from the international community.

Video

Moscow is desperately trying to boost its military as its war on Ukraine continues. In this report by @clare_seb , we see how students are seeing their own professors try to recruit them into the Russian army.

Video

“The damage and destruction that we will see over the course of the next several years will end up being one of the most impactful policy decisions that the Trump administration made.” Former USAID official Nicholas Enrich, author of “Into the Woodchipper,” warns me about the global impact of the White House dismantling the agency.

Video

“I watched in real time as the agency was shredded in the most cruel and indifferent way that you could imagine.” In his book “Into the Woodchipper,” USAID whistleblower Nicholas Enrich describes witnessing America’s foreign aid agency being dismantled from the inside.

Video

Palestinian author Aziz Abu Sarah reads me a passage from his book “The Future is Peace,” co-written with Israeli Maoz Inon. He calls for all of us to travel with them on the path of peace.

Video

“Yes, I lost my parents on October 7, but I won this. I won Aziz as a brother.” Palestinian Aziz Abu Sarah and Israeli Maoz Inon tell the personal story behind their inspiring new book, “The Future is Peace.”

Video

“I used to play sports, and you'd be playing against people who talked a lot of trash. The only thing that really matters is the outcome of the contest.” Retired Four-Star General Stanley McChrystal says the White House should let their actions on the ground tell their story in the Iran war.

Video

“We’ve had a very apolitical military, and we want that. We don’t want Republican and Democratic generals.” I speak to Retired Four-Star General Stanley McChrystal about Pentagon personnel decisions based on DEI and other political factors.

Video

Using the Pentagon podium to lash out at journalists in extreme biblical terms is unprecedented, misguided, and frankly wrong on the substance. Ever since Sunday School Catholic classes, I have been well aware of the Scribes and the Pharisees. They were the bad guys against Jesus, the good guy… in current U.S. good v evil war parlance. Bearing witness to the truth is what we journalists are commanded to do, without fear nor favor.
I am also well aware of the Ten Commandments, and therefore urge

The Gazification Method, per the Israeli government, not only for Gaza, but also Lebanon, and Iran… with the United States. See this @nytimes investigation on people killed and civilian infrastructure struck.
